children: Lyft appointed Michael Brous as Chief Financial Officer, effective September 28, 2026, with Erin Brewer retiring from the CFO role and serving as an advisor through December 15, 2026.
Selected for financial expertise in mobility and investing and deep company knowledge from nearly eight-year tenure
Retirement; departure not due to any dispute or disagreement with the Company, board, or management

Age 39; Head of Lyft Urban Solutions & Safety & Customer Care since Nov 2025; prior roles include Head of Lyft Urban Solutions, Head of Strategy and Growth, Co-Head of Operations, Head of FP&A prior roles at Motivate, REQX Ventures, Versa Capital, Financo; B.S. Finance, Wharton.
Will serve as advisor through Dec 15, 2026 and continue vesting in outstanding equity during consulting term

title: Lyft appoints Michael Brous as CFO as Erin Brewer to retire
